scope: production Headless API transport with synthetic compute; excludes full app/agent/storage

reason: Client-visible latency improvement is inconsistent; H2 P99 regresses in some pairs and server RSS rises around 4-7%. CPU benefits alone do not meet admission. Slow-consumer/cancellation/full-application/native-framework coverage remains missing.

request_child_ownership.problem: after connection EOF, response sender can remain blocked in H2 StreamBuffer.push; request parent cancellation did not join child tasks; SSE wrapper close deferred nested iterator finalization
request_child_ownership.decision: both Quart shells select a shared lazy HTTP connection class owning only their receiver/handler tasks; every exit joins unfinished children, including creation rollback; both SSE views explicitly close nested event iterators
